title: VillageCraft 2 Essentials
description: The custom mod used in the VillageCraft 2 Modpack.
body:
![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/994371/description_008da454-7fad-4952-a1fc-75aa5aecc0ff.png)   VillageCraft 2 Essentials is a mod build for the VillageCraft 2 Modpack which is used on the VillageCraft 2 Server, a private youtube SMP. This mod adds custom ores to use as currency, which are copies of diamonds in every way. The other feature added is the ATM, a block which allows you to exchange currencies, including diamond into emerald with set exchange rates.    Versions labelbed pre-v0.x are pre-releases of the first major version. These versions do not contain all features and may not work correctly.   ## **Installation Requirements**   ###### [![NeoForged · GitHub](https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/138629134?s=160&v=4)](https://projects.neoforged.net/neoforged/neoforge) ## **FAQ**
Spoiler

Q: When will VillageCraft 2 Essentials be ported to version x?

A: It will never be updated to versions before or after 1.21.1 because that is the version that VillageCraft 2 Server and Modpack will always use.



Q: Will VillageCraft 2 Essentials be ported to another modloader, e.g. Fabric or back to Forge?

A: It will stay on Neoforge as that is the modloader VillageCraft 2 Server and Modpack will always use. Since we have moved on from Forge for this project.

 

Q: Can I use this mod in my own Modpacks?

A: Yes, if you provide credit to Timeship. (The development team)

 

Q: Can I create Videos on the mod?

A: Of course. Just make sure the viewers know you are not apart of the actual server.

 

Q: Can I Repost this mod?

A: No. Do not repost this modpack anywhere publicaly. The only place players should be able to download it is on Curseforge.
